name: french_article_agreement
description: Select le/la/les for French nouns with grammatical gender and number; control repeats the supplied noun in the same format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
masc=['chat','chien','livre','jardin','garçon','vélo','bureau','train','soleil','village']; fem=['maison','table','fille','porte','voiture','fleur','chaise','route','ville','plage'];items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 female=random.choice([True,False]); plural=random.choice([True,False]); noun=random.choice(fem if female else masc); noun=noun+('s' if plural else '');article='les' if plural else ('la' if female else 'le')
 prefix=f'Nom français : {noun}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'Article défini (le, la ou les) :','answer':' '+article})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'Répétez le nom :','answer':' '+noun})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
